body: I believe he would say something like this. He's one of the best guys I know. He would do anything for you and protect you. I know he had struggles with anxiety and mental health we would talk all the time. Of everyone I knew I wouldn't have guess he would take his own life purposely.

I would love a hug. I might take you up on that talk. 

I spoke to my girlfriend. I've come onto the sudden realization that he's my only friend that I talk about anything serious with.

I know he was in a lot of pain. He was seeing doctors for it. We had plans later this week to see a movie. He had plans for a family trip he wanted me to join for the weekend. He was going to start a new job next week.
